full_name: Congress of the International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS Congress)
organizer: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS), with the host country's member society as local organizer (e.g., AIDAA 2024, FTF 2022, KSAS 2016)

submission.type: extended abstract or draft manuscript (minimum 1,000 words, with key figures/equations/references) plus a max 50-word program summary; full paper (mandatory ICAS template) after acceptance
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: January of the congress year (1 Jan 2024; 10 Jan 2026 extended to 24 Jan 2026); 10 Feb in 2022
submission.typical_final_deadline: 1-15 June of the congress year (1 Jun 2022 and 2024; 15 Jun 2026)
submission.notes: Abstract requirement quoted from the ICAS 2024 Call for Papers (https://ftfsweden.se/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/ICAS-2024-Call-for-Papers.pdf). Notification around end of March. No full-paper page limit verified.

editions.notes: 27th Congress. Venue not verified (possibly Acropolis, Nice - unconfirmed).
28th Congress. Venue from pre-congress status report https://spaceref.com/?p=123919 (secondary).
29th Congress (https://www.icas.org/icas_archive/ICAS2014/data/index.html). Dates from proceedings catalogue records; venue not verified.
31st Congress; first in South America. Venue Expominas from a Brazilian news brief https://diariodocomercio.com.br/?p=7148 (secondary).

32nd Congress 'ICAS 2020/21': originally 14-18 Sep 2020, postponed due to COVID-19 to 6-10 Sep 2021 and held as a hybrid congress (https://ftfsweden.se/?p=8588). Year kept as nominal 2020; actual dates in 2021. Venue not verified.
33rd Congress, hosted by FTF. Dates/timeline also on https://aiaa.org/events/33rd-congress-of-the-international-council-of-the-aeronautical-sciences-icas/; full papers due 1 Jun 2022.
34th Congress, hosted by AIDAA. Answer by 31 Mar 2024; full paper by 1 Jun 2024. A possible extension to 15 Jan 2024 was seen only on a non-ICAS calendar site - not verified.

editions.venue: International Convention & Exhibition Centre Sydney (ICC Sydney)
editions.notes: 35th Congress. Abstract deadline originally 10 Jan 2026, extended to 24 Jan 2026 23:59 CET; notifications 18 Mar 2026; full paper 15 Jun 2026. icas.org states 13-17 Sep 2026 while icas2026.com states 13-18 Sep 2026 (congress site used). Cross-checked 2026-10-16: end_date 2026-09-18 kept; icas2026.com Key dates show "13-18 September 2026" (icas.org: 13-17; 18 Sep = technical tours). Abstract deadline 24 Jan 2026 re-confirmed on https://icas2026.dglr.de/.
36th Congress: September 2028 in Montreal, Canada; ICAS says exact dates have not been fixed yet.

notes: ICAS 2028 (36th) Montreal: month only (September 2028); dates, venue and call for papers not yet published as of 2026-10-16. Based on past cycles the abstract deadline would likely fall around January 2028 (inference, not announced). Abstract deadlines for 2010-2018 and 2020/21 not verified (null). Venues for 2010, 2014 and 2020/21 not verified.
